title: Supreme Petrochem Q2 FY27 Results: Decoding the Dividend and Financial Performance
description: Supreme Petrochem has announced a first interim dividend of ₹2.50 per share for the financial year 2026-27. The company's revenue for Q2 FY27 surged by 77.8% .

faq.a: An interim dividend is a dividend paid by a company to its shareholders before the full financial year's results are finalised and before the Annual General Meeting. It usually reflects strong performance in the initial quarters.

faq.q: What is a record date for a dividend?
faq.a: The record date is a specific date set by a company to determine which shareholders are eligible to receive the declared dividend. Only those shareholders whose names appear in the company's register by the end of the record date will receive the dividend.

faq.q: How is dividend income taxed in India?
faq.a: In India, dividend income received from domestic companies is fully taxable in the hands of the shareholder. It is added to your total income and taxed at your applicable income tax slab rates.

faq.q: How can I find detailed corporate results?
faq.a: Detailed corporate results, including financial statements and management commentary, are typically available on the company's investor relations section of its official website and on the websites of stock exchanges (BSE, NSE) where the company is listed.

faq.q: What is the significance of "PAT nearly doubled"?
faq.a: "PAT nearly doubled" means the company's Profit After Tax (net profit) for the quarter almost became twice as much as it was in the same quarter last year. This indicates strong profitability growth, often due to higher sales, better cost management, or both.
